description: Exactly the original exposed v2 telescope case; original criteria and historical label unchanged. One approved thinking-only attempt.

segments.text: Ariadne owns the brass telescope. Markos borrowed it for the night-sky demonstration; she did not give it to him.
segments.speaker: Speaker 6

segments.text: He must return it to her after the demonstration, even if he finishes early.
segments.speaker: Speaker 6

reference_translations: Η Αριάδνη είναι η ιδιοκτήτρια του ορειχάλκινου τηλεσκοπίου. Ο Μάρκος το δανείστηκε για την επίδειξη του νυχτερινού ουρανού· δεν του το χάρισε.
Πρέπει να της το επιστρέψει μετά την επίδειξη, ακόμη κι αν τελειώσει νωρίς.
review_criteria: Ariadne remains the owner; Markos is the borrower, not the lender or recipient of a gift.
The brass material and the telescope must remain distinct from other observation equipment.
The return obligation remains in force even if Markos finishes early; do not assert that he actually finished early.
